generatedSource.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: cinematic wide website hero photograph illustration, 16:9 landscape. A fictional three-generation Singaporean Chinese family of five warmly sharing dinner around a wooden table in a beautifully understated tropical shophouse home at dusk. Parents, small boy, grandparents with natural happy expressions, candid not posed. Family grouped in right two-thirds, left third mostly dark deep forest green negative space for webpage text, no text in image. Warm champagne gold practical lighting, lush deep green foliage in background, appetizing ordinary shared dishes without any branded packaging. Editorial premium photography, rich filmic shadows, restrained natural color, real human proportions. No logos, no words, no watermark, no historical documents, no claim of real people or company event. Output a single photographic scene, not a website mockup.
